brief: @buildthis.bisks.net 3js pov school classroom, pick your seat online, the teacher rolls in the av cart, shows the foryou.club feed for 1 selected account as a refried slideshow. corecore procedural soundtrack. anyone can select the account, and everyone online sees the same feed & room. be excellent
